description: Check any website's AI visibility with a 7-criteria AEO audit: JSON-LD, llms.txt, AI bots in robots.txt and more. Use when you need to know if a site can be cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity or Claude — this checker returns a 0-7 score with exact fixes plus a generated llms.txt draft. FREE.

generateLlmsTxt.description: Also generate a ready-to-publish llms.txt draft for the audited site (delivered in the dataset and in the key-value store as llms.txt).
generateLlmsTxt.title: Generate llms.txt draft

url.description: Full URL of the site to audit (e.g. https://example.lu). The checker fetches the homepage, /llms.txt and /robots.txt.
url.title: Website URL

name: aeo_ai_visibility_checker
